You will be directed to an external platform where you need to: complete onboarding and training modules, perform various tasks and assignments. Payment will be issued only after you successfully complete the required tasks on the platform.
Update: submission is now automatic
You no longer need to submit anything on this page. Keep labeling task sets on the external platform: every completed set is submitted here automatically, your payment is issued right after, and your next task set is assigned to you right away. This should make your work easier and getting new tasks faster. The controls below remain only as a backup in case automatic submission fails.
